summary: The run has reached its natural time boundary with about fifty seconds of controller time left, so this turn makes no new claim: the draft holds the refinement feedback product the controller already executed (operation 7effecaabe914f8192857df06c965c02, accepted), and preflight had validated these exact bytes with valid:true. No further product is warranted at expiry. Final state of the investigation: audit spec v13, every unit checked, and eleven confirmed in-scope obligations, each carried by a fixed artifact that the trusted runner executed and that then passed review with no open issue - election-term context published below an adopted term (both a substitute stream layer and the production TCP transport); client requests left unresolved on an inactive raft, and a request accepted while leading left unresolved after shutdown; a second, different vote persisted for the same term; two leaders of one term, with the overlap-window variant recorded as a bounded negative that holds; GetConfiguration reporting index zero for a configuration established at index one; a reported commit index naming an entry the voting quorum does not store; a leader with a reachable quorum stepping down under the lease check; the commit context left below applied state on the install path with the log intact, again with the log truncated at the snapshot index, and again after a restart that restores the node's own snapshot; and VerifyLeader confirming leadership on non-voter acknowledgements with one non-voter against two voters and with two non-voters against three voters. Two anomalies were investigated and explained rather than reported: the cached last-log report versus the effective last index after a snapshot is adopted, and the non-voter election suspicion, which the located suffrage guard on both the vote and pre-vote paths refutes. Open items carried forward: the repair locations for the whole set with no source naming the intended layer; no external consumer exercised for the client-contract findings; the campaign path of a server without a vote only partly read; the transfer path accepting a non-voter target and reporting success with no leader established, uncovered by any obligation; and the deferred third-party SetHeartbeatHandler transports, the MonotonicLogStore and snapshot-compaction interplay, the nested fuzzy and raft-compat modules, and mixed reachable-voter/non-voter layouts. Unused capacity at expiry: 2 audit units, 19 experiments, 9 semantic reviews and 12 revisions.
